description: Exempts installation of the Redline Carbon Fiber Power Scoop, a carbon fiber snorkel that connects directly to the original air intake box without modifying the ECU, on the listed Subaru WRX model years.
notes: 3-page document, fully legible. Part number '746150-RMC' has a matte finish; '746150' (without RMC) has a gloss finish -- same fitment otherwise. Engine listed in Exhibit A as '2.4L TC' (TC = turbocharged), hence induction TURBO.
